children: Sandoz Group plans a major expansion of its biosimilar-drug portfolio over the coming decade and a half, but this effort will initially rely on external assets, J.P. Morgan analysts say in a research note. The Swiss maker of generic drugs on Tuesday set out plans to increase the number of biosimilars--copycat versions ofbiologic drugs--in its portfolio to 100 by 2030 from 13 currently. "Post 2035, the company aims to focus on in-house development, but through to the end of the decade expansion in the biosimilar opportunity will primarily be realized through additional partnerships, while a combination of approaches will be pursued from 2030-35," the analysts say. Sandoz shares fall 1.3%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
